oxidns.native_config:
# 手工原生底稿，不能被重新套模板
custom_extension:
  保留: true
runtime:
  worker_threads: 2
api:
  http:
    listen: 127.0.0.1:9199
log:
  level: info
plugins:
- tag: rules_domain_1
  type: domain_set
  args:
    exps:
    - full:refused.example.test
- tag: rules_domain_2
  type: domain_set
  args:
    exps:
    - full:missing.example.test
- tag: rules_domain_3
  type: domain_set
  args:
    exps:
    - full:empty.example.test
- tag: rules_domain_4
  type: domain_set
  args:
    exps:
    - keyword:ads
- tag: rules_domain_5
  type: domain_set
  args:
    exps:
    - full:pinned.example.test
- tag: rules_domain_6
  type: domain_set
  args:
    files:
    - ./rules/rule_3c7c4bd3265bc0f8_domain.txt
- tag: custom_hosts
  type: hosts
  args:
    files:
    - ./rules/custom_hosts.txt
- tag: lazy_cache
  type: cache
  args:
    size: 10240
    lazy_cache_ttl: 60
    short_circuit: true
- tag: local_probe_cache
  type: cache
  args:
    size: 2048
    short_circuit: false
- tag: forward_local
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 2
    upstreams:
    - addr: udp://192.168.50.53
- tag: forward_remote
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 1
    upstreams:
    - addr: udp://203.0.113.53
- tag: forward_fallback
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 2
    upstreams:
    - addr: udp://1.1.1.1
- tag: query_recorder
  type: query_recorder
  args:
    path: ./state/queries.db
    queue_size: 8192
    batch_size: 256
    flush_interval_ms: 200
    memory_tail: 1024
    retention_days: 7
    cleanup_interval_hours: 1
    reader_concurrency: 2
- tag: china_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $lazy_cache
  - exec: $forward_local
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
- tag: local_probe
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $local_probe_cache
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: $forward_local
  - exec: return
- tag: remote_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $forward_remote
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
  - exec: ttl 120
- tag: fallback_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $forward_fallback
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
- tag: fallback
  type: fallback
  args:
    primary: remote_dns
    secondary: fallback_dns
    threshold: 500
    always_standby: false
- tag: proxy_dns_seq
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $fallback
  - exec: accept
- tag: default_direct_ip
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: accept
- tag: direct_ip
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: accept
- tag: ip_requery_proxy
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: drop_resp
  - exec: goto proxy_dns_seq
- tag: cf_dns_blackhole
  type: black_hole
  args:
    mode: 'null'
    short_circuit: true
- tag: cf_dns_fwd_0c8dac524a31
  type: forward
  args:
    upstreams:
    - addr: udp://9.9.9.9
- tag: cf_dns_cache_0c8dac524a31
  type: cache
  args:
    size: 1024
    lazy_cache_ttl: 60
    short_circuit: true
- tag: cf_dns_up_0c8dac524a31
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: drop_resp
  - exec: $cf_dns_cache_0c8dac524a31
  - exec: $cf_dns_fwd_0c8dac524a31
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
  - exec: ttl 120
  - exec: accept
- tag: sequence_main
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: metrics_collector metrics
  - exec: $query_recorder
  - exec: prefer_ipv4
  - matches:
    - qtype 65 255
    exec: black_hole nodata short_circuit=true
  - exec: $custom_hosts
  - matches:
    - has_resp
    exec: accept
  - matches:
    - qname domain:custom.test
    exec: goto china_dns
  - matches:
    - qname $rules_domain_1
    exec: reject
  - matches:
    - qname $rules_domain_2
    exec: reject 3
  - matches:
    - qname $rules_domain_3
    exec: reject 0
  - matches:
    - qname $rules_domain_4
    exec: $cf_dns_blackhole
  - matches:
    - qname $rules_domain_5
    exec: goto cf_dns_up_0c8dac524a31
  - matches:
    - qname $rules_domain_6
    exec: $cf_dns_blackhole
  - exec: goto proxy_dns_seq
- tag: server_udp
  type: udp_server
  args:
    listen: 0.0.0.0:53
    entry: sequence_main
- tag: server_tcp
  type: tcp_server
  args:
    listen: 0.0.0.0:53
    entry: sequence_main
- tag: rules_download
  type: download
  args:
    timeout: 60s
    downloads:
    - url: https://config.test/api/profiles/golden-space/mosdns/rule-proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Frules.test%2Fads.yaml&part=domain&token=fixture-token
      dir: rules
      filename: rule_3c7c4bd3265bc0f8_domain.txt
- tag: rules_reload
  type: reload_provider
  args:
  - $rules_domain_1
  - $rules_domain_2
  - $rules_domain_3
  - $rules_domain_4
  - $rules_domain_5
  - $rules_domain_6
- tag: rules_refresh
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $rules_download
  - exec: $rules_reload
- tag: custom_passthrough
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: return
native_extension:
  keep:
  - 真实底稿
  - false
  - 0
oxidns.custom_config:
custom_extension:
  保留: true
plugins:
  - tag: custom_passthrough
    type: sequence
    args:
      - exec: return
